Effect: You cast the ritual without expending any of the ritual's gold piece component cost. Any focus item the ritual requires must still meet its minimum cost. Instead, you expend one healing surge, and the ritual takes twice as long to cast. If you roll a 20 on the ritual's skill check, you regain the healing surge expended for this power; if the ritual does not require a skill check, you can make one anyway to try to gain this benefit. You cannot use this power on any ritual that creates or enchants an item, su ch as Brew Potion or Enchant Magic Item.

powers.title: Circle of Protection from Energy
powers.description: You hold the circle and the circle holds the fire out.
powers.traits: Arcane, Non-Combat, Ritual, Warding, Battle Preparation
rows: Special: Choose one of the energy types when you first gain this power. Your resistance against that energy type increases by your level.
Cast Time: 1 minute.

Effect: Choose a damage type among fire, cold, acid, lightning, or thunder, and roll an Arcana check. While you perform this ritual, you and allies within the burst have resistance to that damage type equal to your Arcana check result. You can sustain the ritual f or up to 1 hour, but you must be performing it that entire time instead of moving or taking other actions. Each ally who assists the ritual may instead increase the maximum duration by 1 hour or the area of effect by 2 squares, rather than adding to the Arcana check.

powers.title: Improved Dispel Magic Ritual
powers.description: Given an hour and no one shouting at you, very little stays wove
rows: Prerequisite: You have the Dispel Magic power (Wizard 6).
Cast Time: 1 hour.
Cost: 100 gp per level of the magical effect.

Effect: Outside of combat, you can destroy a magical effect that originates from an arcane power source. Roll an Arcana check against 10 + the level of the creature that created the effect, or its estimated level. This check is modified by the general permanence o f the magical effect - either how long it has already lasted in the area or how long it was meant to last, the DM's choice - according to the table below. Permanence Modifier Encounter effect, or less than 1 hour +10 1 hour to less than 1 day +5 1 day to 1 week +0 1 week to less than 1 month -2 1 month to less than 1 year -5 1 year to less than 100 years -10, and 2 healing surges must be spent More than 100 years N/A Effects that have lasted more than 100 years are part of the weave of that area now. More extensive rituals are generally required to dispel those, ones usually obtained as part of the story.

powers.title: Inexhaustible Flame
powers.description: The fire takes your meaning and refuses to be argued with.
rows: Target: One existing fire within range

Effect: A campfire, bonfire, or other existing fire on a flammable object cannot be extinguished by any outside mundane means. It can still run out of fuel, but dousing it with water or smothering its air will not work. Roll an Arcana check to determine how long t his lasts. Check Result Max Duration 10 or less 10 minutes 11 - 20 1 hour 21 - 30 24 hours 31 - 40 1 week 41 or higher 1 year The DM may allow powerful magical effects to work, but should require the caster to make an attack against your Will. See the master improvisation chart, or simply use d20 + the caster's level for the attack.

powers.title: Mass Animation
powers.description: The room stands up all at once and waits to be told what it is fo
rows: Target: Up to 10 nonmagical objects within the burst that are not fastened down or held by a creature. Medium objects count as two, Large objects count as four, and Huge objects count as eight. You cannot animate Huge or larger objects.

Effect: Each target animates until the end of your next turn, hovering above the ground with a fly speed of 5. You may immediately move all target objects up to their speed. While a target is animated by this power, you can move it 5 squares through the air, and i t retains the ability to fly and hover. You may also use a minor action to have any number of target objects begin a mundane task related to their normal function: brooms begin sweeping, pots begin stirring, and so on. You cannot make attacks with the objects, even if it appears you can. A sword may flick and slice in the air, but with no aim or power behind it.
Sustain Move: The animation persists until the end of your next turn for objects within 100 squares (about 500 feet), and you may move all target objects up to 5 squares.

powers.title: Form of the Sprinting Elk
powers.description: Your form shifts as you assume the guise of a great elk and quickly bound away.
rows: Effect: You assume the form of the sprinting elk until you take an extended rest or until you end the form as a free action. While in this form, you gain a +4 bonus to speed, but you cannot attack, manipulate objects, or use any magic item powers. Also, your gear becomes part of the form and is inaccessible.
powers.citation: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 79.

powers.title: Meld into Stone
powers.description: Your body merges with stone, letting you slip out of sight and away from harm.
rows: Effect: You shift into an adjacent square occupied by an object made of stone or earth that is your size or larger, such as a wall, a statue, or a boulder. While you occupy this square, you can see normally but you do not have line of effect to anything, and nothing has line of effect to you. You remain in this state until the end of the encounter, until you end this effect as a minor action, or until the object is destroyed. When the effect ends, you appear in the nearest unoccupied square.
powers.citation: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 80.

powers.title: Animal Shapes
powers.description: You transform yourself and your allies into mice, beetles, or other seemingly innocuous animals.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the targets assume the forms of Tiny creatures, such as mice, cats, beetles, or spiders. While in these forms, the targets can't attack, pick up anything, or manipulate objects. The targets gain a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks and a +2 power bonus to AC and Reflex. Each target can end this effect on himself or herself as a minor action.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists on yourself and any target within 5 squares of you.

powers.title: Sea Stride
powers.description: You draw on the strength of flowing water to glide through the waves with ease.
rows: Effect: You gain a swim speed equal to your speed until the end of your turn.

powers.title: Sylvan Trickery
powers.description: Your faerie allies cloak you in fey magic to hide you and speed you away.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target becomes invisible until the end of his or her next turn or until he or she makes an attack. When the invisibility ends, the target can teleport up to 3 squares.

powers.title: Primal Gust
powers.description: A gust moves an ally or an enemy into position.
rows: Target: One creature
Effect: You slide the target 3 squares.

powers.title: Twilight's Veil
powers.description: You reach into the spirit world, weaving together strands of primal night to cloak yourself and your allies in a veil of invisibility
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target becomes invisible until he or she attacks or until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Stonebreaker
powers.description: Without hesitation, you smash through the door.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to Strength checks to break objects, and you deal double damage against objects.

powers.title: Climber's Claws
powers.description: Thick claws spring from your hands, allowing you to scale surfaces quickly.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a climb speed equal to your speed.

powers.title: Burrowing Stride
powers.description: You dive into the earth and reappear some distance from your starting point.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you can use a move action to move either your speed through loose earth or half your speed through solid stone. You must end the move in an unoccupied space.
